events.s: 07:00–09:00 arrivals at Reception and Gatehouse; 09:00 Headmaster and Vice Headmaster speeches in the Arbiter Hall, then Stone sorting until 10:00 (Council hands out each dorm vest; sorted students remain seated with their dorm); 10:00–18:00 assigned tour groups of two new first-years and one senior, meeting in the hall, visit campus and club booths (sign-up open until Friday 18:00); late afternoon: seniors show new students their dorm rooms; 19:00 Entrance Feast in the Ring Dining Hall, opened by speeches from the Headmaster and Vice Headmaster before dinner

events.t: Club sign-up week (club booths after classes)

s.Tue: Classes as usual; 16:00–18:00 club booths across the academy
s.Wed: Classes as usual; 16:00–18:00 club booths across the academy
s.Thu: Classes as usual; 16:00–18:00 club booths across the academy
s.Fri: Classes as usual; 16:00–18:00 club booths across the academy; last day: club registration closes at 18:00

events.t: Star Night (Sat evening to Sun dawn; no 8pm curfew)

s.Sat: Sunset to sunrise, no 8pm curfew; 20:00–00:00 night market near the Grassy Field and Hills (students and mall vendors); stargazing on the hills, tents and bedrolls; midnight: the great meteor shower (a wish made during it is believed to come true)
s.Sun: Until dawn: students sleep out on the Grassy Field and Hills; the curfew is back from dawn

events.s: Viridian Dormitory: 09:00–18:00 open house: the common room shows the dorm's history and the founding warden is honoured with a small rite at the entrance; upperclassmen showcase casting in the courtyard, first-years run booths, a public lesson for outsiders, food stalls, type contests open to all and the dorm tournament; 19:00 dorm-only closing dinner, first-years welcomed with a token of belonging

events.t: Warding Rite (Fri dusk to Sat dawn; the whole academy renews the wards)

s.Fri: Classes as usual while staff build a giant magic circle in the Main Courtyard all day; dusk (about 18:30): the Bell Tower rings a special pattern and every student gathers in the courtyard; speeches from the Headmaster, the Vice Headmaster and the Warden; the Dorm Heads lead each dorm through the shared working; then a feast in the Ring Dining Hall, opened by speeches from the Headmaster and Vice Headmaster
s.Sat: Until dawn: the feast runs late after the working

events.t: Creature Studies Expedition (off-grounds, Grade III country)

s.Wed: 07:00 airships leave, one per year level (half a day to the Grand Vast Forest); afternoon: make camp (tents, cookfires, watch rotations) and prepare gear
s.Thu: Morning: each group of four is assigned a beast to bring back within 24 hours (Years 1–2 Grade III, Year 3 Grade II); staff shadow at a distance and pull out groups in trouble
s.Fri: Morning: break camp and fly home, back on campus by evening; catches count dead or alive

s.Mon: 08:00 Magic Theory, 10:00 Etiquette (written papers); afternoon free
s.Tue: 08:00 History (written); 13:00–16:00 Potion Crafting practical (one brew from a sealed brief)
s.Wed: 08:00–16:00 Dark Magic Defense practicals, one student at a time against the teacher (marked on how long they hold)
s.Thu: 08:00–16:00 Combat practicals, students paired within their year, marked by combat role

s.Fri: Classes in the morning; 13:00–18:00 every club runs a stand in the Main Courtyard: demonstrations, exhibition matches, sales, food
s.Sat: 09:00–18:00 stands and exhibition matches all day; everyone drops one gold coin at the best stand (never their own club); the winner is announced at the close, 18:00

events.s: Classes as usual; from 16:00 the Combat Grounds, duelling rings and practice halls stay open and supervised into the evening; sparring across years and dorms; curfew 21:00

s.Sat: 09:00–18:00 solo ranking bouts inside each dorm, open to the whole dorm
s.Sun: 09:00–18:00 the ranking bouts finish; every entrant gets a placement and the top 16 of each dorm qualify for the Academy Competition

events.t: Secret Fools Day (prank day, dorm name-draw)
events.s: Morning: participants draw a dorm-mate's name in secret, then prank them without warning all day; classes still run; Merryhew's biggest sale of the year

events.t: Independence Crowning Day (airship trip to the capital; fireworks on campus at night; curfew 22:00)
events.s: 07:00 speeches from the Headmaster and Vice Headmaster to the assembled academy, then the whole academy flies to the capital; morning: parade and the King's speech; free time in groups of four (coin only) until the afternoon muster; back before dark, passenger lists counted twice; night: fireworks over the lake beyond Willow Island, watched from the Grassy Field and Hills and the shore; the airship moored beyond the Menagerie and the Gymnasium; curfew 22:00

Light Dormitory: 09:00–18:00 open house: the common room shows the dorm's history and the founding warden is honoured with a small rite at the entrance; upperclassmen showcase casting in the courtyard, first-years run booths, a public lesson for outsiders, food stalls, type contests open to all and the dorm tournament; 19:00 dorm-only closing dinner, first-years welcomed with a token of belonging
08:00–18:00 the single practical trial, one student at a time: theory door, beast, potion, cursed room, examiner in role, duel with a staff member; Royal Inspectorate examiners watch from the gallery

events.t: Results & Dorm Ranking (Player.Profile.Dorm_rank is updated today)
events.s: 09:00 assembly in the Arbiter Hall, opened by speeches from the Headmaster and Vice Headmaster: trial results stage by stage, then the new dorm ranking read aloud last; 19:00 speeches from the Headmaster and Vice Headmaster, then the feast in the Ring Dining Hall

s.Mon: Morning: airships leave; staying is allowed (the canteen runs short hours, half the mall is closed)
s.Sun: Airships bring the students back during the day

events.s: 09:00–18:00 events, no magic: running and team events on the Sports Field, crowd contests in the Main Courtyard, the rest at the lake and the Combat Grounds; medals tallied by dorm at the day's end
09:00–18:00 knockout matches between the cross-dorm teams of four; the winning team represents the academy

s.Mon: Stands are built in the Main Courtyard through the week; classes as usual
s.Tue: Stands are built in the Main Courtyard; classes as usual
s.Wed: Stands are built in the Main Courtyard; classes as usual
s.Thu: Last day of building; classes as usual
s.Fri: Classes in the morning; 13:00–18:00 set-up and viewing in the Main Courtyard
s.Sat: 09:00–18:00 judging: a staff panel questions and scores every stand

events.t: The Thinning: the seal is at its weakest; academy locked down all week
events.s: All week: absolute curfew, academy locked, nobody outside

events.t: Traveling Circus visits (Thu evening to Sun)

s.Thu: Evening: the great tent opens in the Main Courtyard; stands, games, sideshows and fortune tellers across the grounds (stalls take points); curfew 22:00
s.Fri: Classes in the morning; shows several times a day from the afternoon; curfew 22:00
s.Sat: Classes in the morning; shows several times a day from the afternoon; curfew 22:00
s.Sun: Shows all day, the last one in the evening; curfew 22:00

s.Thu: 09:00–18:00 acts on the Main Courtyard stage; parents and guardians visit (logged at the Gatehouse)
s.Fri: 09:00–18:00 acts on the Main Courtyard stage; families visit
s.Sat: 09:00–18:00 the last acts; scores tallied by dorm in the evening to name the most talented dorm

events.s: Fire Dormitory: 09:00–18:00 open house: the common room shows the dorm's history and the founding warden is honoured with a small rite at the entrance; upperclassmen showcase casting in the courtyard, first-years run booths, a public lesson for outsiders, food stalls, type contests open to all and the dorm tournament; 19:00 dorm-only closing dinner, first-years welcomed with a token of belonging

s.Mon: 08:00 Magic Theory, 10:00 Etiquette (written papers); afternoon free
s.Tue: 08:00 History (written); 13:00–16:00 Potion Crafting practical (one brew from a sealed brief)
s.Wed: 08:00–16:00 Dark Magic Defense practicals, one student at a time against the teacher (marked on how long they hold)
s.Thu: 08:00–16:00 Combat practicals, students paired within their year, marked by combat role

events.s: 09:00–18:00 invited traders fill the Main Courtyard (stalls take points, haggling expected); traders logged at the Gatehouse, the Doves watch the stock and the crowd

09:00 speeches from the Headmaster and Vice Headmaster in the Arbiter Hall, then a short rite at the Founder's Statue; all day: the optional treasure hunt across the campus; 19:00 speeches from the Headmaster and Vice Headmaster, then the feast in the Ring Dining Hall

events.t: Halvard's Kingdom Competition team flies to the capital
events.s: Only the team and Gavlan Haverton, its escort, travel: morning airship to the capital, the rest of the day settling in at the hotel near the arena where all four academies' teams stay; everyone else at Halvard has classes as usual

events.t: Kingdom Competition (four academies, one team each)
events.s: 09:00–18:00 knockout matches between the four academies' teams at the arena in the capital; each member of the winning team earns 5,000 points. Only the teams travel: Halvard's team stays at the capital hotel with Gavlan Haverton, its escort; everyone else at Halvard has classes as usual and follows the news

events.t: Halvard's Kingdom Competition team flies home
events.s: The team and Gavlan Haverton check out of the capital hotel and fly home by airship, back at Halvard by evening

All day: nothing loud (no clubs, duelling, music, games or sport); classes run quietly, the Bell Tower keeps a slow pattern, bouquets line the halls; evening (about 19:00) on the Grassy Field and Hills: speeches from the Headmaster, the Vice Headmaster and Acting Warden Rei, then the lantern release, one lantern each

Sky Dormitory: 09:00–18:00 open house: the common room shows the dorm's history and the founding warden is honoured with a small rite at the entrance; upperclassmen showcase casting in the courtyard, first-years run booths, a public lesson for outsiders, food stalls, type contests open to all and the dorm tournament; 19:00 dorm-only closing dinner, first-years welcomed with a token of belonging

s.Mon: Classes as usual; after classes the two Council nominees begin campaigning across the dorms with brochures, posters and conversations
s.Tue: Classes as usual; outside class the Council nominees continue their campaigns, distributing brochures and speaking to students
s.Wed: Classes as usual; the nominees campaign outside class and answer students across the dorms
s.Thu: Classes as usual; final campaign day for brochures, posters and student conversations
s.Fri: Classes as usual; 16:00-18:00 the two nominees debate in the Seminar Rooms and answer students' questions
s.Sat: Morning Etiquette and Study Hall as usual; 13:00-16:00 private presidential voting in the Main Courtyard replaces every club meeting; after counting, the winner names the losing candidate Vice President-elect

s.Fri: Classes as usual; from 17:00 cafés, food stalls, game booths, haunted houses and stage acts, costumes and carved lanterns; families visit (logged at the Gatehouse); curfew 23:00
s.Sat: 09:00 until late: the festival all day; curfew 23:00
s.Sun: The festival all day; evening: fireworks over the lake, watched from the Grassy Field and Hills; the usual curfew

events.s: 08:00–18:00 the single practical trial, one student at a time: theory door, beast, potion, cursed room, examiner in role, duel with a staff member; Royal Inspectorate examiners watch from the gallery

events.t: Results & Final Ranking (Player.Profile.Dorm_rank is updated today)
events.s: 09:00 assembly in the Arbiter Hall, opened by speeches from the Headmaster and Vice Headmaster: trial results stage by stage, then the final dorm ranking read aloud last; 19:00 speeches from the Headmaster and Vice Headmaster, then the feast in the Ring Dining Hall

s.Sat: 07:00 airships leave Halvard: a full day's flight to Sunreach Bay (meals and the promenade aboard); arrival at night, check-in at the beachfront hotels, four to a room; the teachers set a curfew
s.Sun: Free time in groups of four (the day side only; the night side is out of bounds); the teachers' curfew

s.Mon: Free time in groups of four (the day side only; the night side is out of bounds); the teachers' curfew
s.Tue: Free time in groups of four (the day side only; the night side is out of bounds); the teachers' curfew
s.Wed: Last full day: free time in groups of four (the day side only); pack in the evening; the teachers' curfew
s.Thu: Morning: check out and board; a full day's flight home, back at Halvard by night

events.s: Abroad: the national four compete; the rest of the academy follows the news

events.t: Graduation (everyone attends; third-years leave by airship next morning)
events.s: 09:00 ceremony in the Arbiter Hall: the Headmaster and Vice Headmaster speak, the Dorm Heads read out their graduates, each touches the Arbiter Stone a last time; afternoon: recruitment tables (noble houses, the Royal Inspectorate, the Dovecote, the Bank, hunting companies, guilds); from 12:00 the farewell winter market in the Main Courtyard and Founder's Park (stalls, snowmen if there is snow, the Farewell Pine, the Music Club on a small stage by the statue); dusk: the airship for the graduates moors above the Grassy Field; 19:00 the Headmaster and Vice Headmaster speak once more, then the farewell feast

Fri: Dark Magic Defense practical [D] (Doves; Combat Grounds or warded seminar room)

months.1: W1 Mon Entrance Event (09:00 speeches then sorting until 10:00, assigned trio tours 10:00-18:00, 19:00 speeches and feast). W1 Tue-Fri club booths 16:00-18:00, club registration closes Fri 18:00. W3 Sat evening to Sun dawn Star Night. W4 Sun Spiritual Dorm Day.
months.2: W1 Fri dusk to Sat dawn Warding Rite (whole academy renews the wards). W3 Wed-Fri Creature Studies Expedition (off-grounds, Grade III country).
months.3: W1 Mon-Thu Midterm. W2 Fri-Sat Club Festival. W3 Mon-Sat Training Week (the one week cross-dorm sparring is allowed). W4 Sat-Sun Dorm Competition (solo, top 16 qualify).
months.4: W1 Wed Secret Fools Day (prank day, dorm name-draw). W2 Tue Independence Crowning Day (kingdom holiday: the academy flies to the capital by airship; fireworks on campus at night). W3 Sun Mystic Dorm Day. W4 normal classes.
months.5: W1 Mon-Thu End of Semester exams. W2 Fri Results & Dorm Ranking. W3 open. W4 Mid-Year Break, students go home.
months.6: W1 Mon-Fri Return Week. W3 Sat Sports Day (magic banned outright). W4 Wed-Sat Academy Competition (cross-dorm teams of 4).
months.7: W2 Magical & Science Fair. W3 Mon-Sun The Thinning: the seal is at its weakest, the academy is locked down for the week, nobody outside.
months.8: W2 Thu evening to Sun Traveling Circus visits. W3 Thu-Sat Academy Showcase. W4 Sun Elemental Dorm Day.
months.9: W1 Mon-Thu Midterm. W2 Thu-Sat Academy Bazaar. W3 Sat Academy Founder Day. W4 Wed-Sat Kingdom Competition at the arena in the capital (four academies, one team each; only the teams travel, Halvard's with Gavlan Haverton: they fly out Tue and home Sun).
months.10: W1 Tue Remembrance Day. W2 Sun Occult Dorm Day. W3 Mon-Thu Student Council election campaign; W3 Fri 16:00-18:00 debate in the Seminar Rooms; W3 Sat 13:00-16:00 voting in the Main Courtyard replaces clubs, with results after counting. W4 Fri evening to Sun Harvest Festival.
months.11: W1 Mon-Thu End of Semester exams. W2 Mon Results & Final Ranking. W2 Sat to W3 Thu Academy Trip (Sunreach Bay, abroad; a full day by airship each way: out Sat, home Thu). W4 Wed-Sat World Competition, abroad (the national four). W4 Sun Graduation (third-years leave the next morning).
months.12: Kingdom-wide holiday all month, students go home, campus nearly empty.
